sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 The Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 W.P. No.18219 of 2023
Order:

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of the respondents.
2. PERUSED THE RECORD.

3. The prayer as sought for by the petitioners in the present writ petition reads as under:
"to pass an order or orders one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS, declaring the in-action of the respondents in referring the applications of the petitioners made under section 64 of Land Acquisition Act, 30/2013, to the authority, as illegal and arbitrary and consequently direct the respondents to refer the matter to the authority under section 64 of the Act and pass such other order or orders as this Hon'ble High Court deems fit and proper in the interest of justice."

4. It is the specific case of the petitioners that all the petitioners' structures in Kanaipally Village of Kothakota Mandal, Wanaparthy District were acquired since they were in Wp_18219_2023 2 SN,J submergence of the back waters of Shankara Samudram balancing reservoir under Priyadarshini Jurala Project.
The 3rd respondent duly passed an Award vide Award No.03/2017, dated 24.01.2017 by invoking the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.

The 3rd respondent made payment of compensation vide the said award dated 24.01.2017 and having not been satisfied with the quantum of compensation fixed by the 3rd respondent, the petitioners made application dated 25.01.2017 under Section 64 of the Land Acquisition Act, Act 30 of 2013, for reference of the dispute to the Authority and the 3rd respondent though received the said applications failed to make any reference to the Authority established under the Act.
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioners had filed the present writ petition.

5. It is represented by the learned Government Pleader that, the Writ Petition could be disposed of directing the respondents to refer the application of the petitioners dated 25.01.2017 under Section 64 of Land Acquisition Act, 30/2013, to the competent authority by granting a reasonable time.

sentences.text: 1 6. Taking into consideration the above submissions made by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, the writ petition is disposed of directing the Respondents to consider the application of the petitioners, dated 25.01.2017 filed under Section 64 of the "Right to Fair and Transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 seeking for reference of Award No.3 of 2017, dated 23.01.2017 in respect of the petitioner's house bearing No.397/1 to an extent of 79.05 cents, for re-determination of compensation awarded to the petitioners, to the Competent authority, within a period of four (04) weeks from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall also stand closed.
SUREPALLI NANDA, J Date: 12.07.2023 ksl Wp_18219_2023 4 SN,J THE HONOURABLE SMT.
